Renew Physical Therapy is an outpatient physical therapy clinic in Bentonville, AR, USA. We specialize in pelvic health physical therapy. Welcome to our YouTube Channel!

***Disclaimer: This channel is intended to provide general information regarding common conditions we see in the clinic. It is not to be used in place of medical advice.  Please consult your healthcare provider for appropriate diagnosis and treatment and do not use these resources as a way to avoid getting treatment.****
